agent.description: Activated agent ID from ListCodingAgents; use that tool to discover credential kinds, capabilities, endpoints and supported driver options.

account_id.description: Account ID from ListCodingAccounts. Omit to balance across eligible accounts; an explicit account remains pinned. Empty clears a profile account selection.

image_id.description: Prepared image ID from ListCodingImages, compatible with the selected agent. ReadCodingImage exposes build status and the latest log.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID from ListCodingWorkspaces. Omit for an ephemeral scratch directory; an empty value overrides a profile workspace with scratch. Registered workspaces mount according to caller grants.

prompt.description: Task instructions, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes. Submission returns asynchronously; use ListCodingRuns or ReadCodingRun for completion.

repo_url.description: Optional repository URL to clone into scratch. Omit for a plain scratch directory. A registered workspace uses its existing checkout. Do not embed credentials, query strings or URL fragments.

options.description: Driver-specific option values from ListCodingAgents. Task keys override matching profile keys and unattended presets; omitted keys inherit defaults.

unattended.description: Apply the driver unattended preset when true. Explicit driver options override the preset; omission uses the profile or driver default.

timeout.description: Run duration such as 30m or 2h, from 1m through 168h (7 days). Overrides the profile run_timeout; omission uses the profile or configured default.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-scoped retry key. Reuse it with the same request to recover the original run; changing that request with the same key returns a conflict.

input.description: Optional JSON input, encoded separately from prompt; at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes after JSON serialization. The runner appends it after prompt as Input:.

repo_ref.description: Optional branch or tag for a scratch clone; omitted or empty uses the remote default. Registered workspaces keep their current ref and refuse this field.

profile_id.description: Profile ID from ListCodingProfiles; ReadCodingProfile shows its defaults. Explicit task fields and option keys override the selected profile.

account_pool.description: Eligible account IDs from ListCodingAccounts for balancing. A task pool overrides the profile pool and clears its pinned account unless account_id is also supplied.

protocol.description: Endpoint protocol supported by the selected ListCodingAgents entry.

base_url.description: Custom endpoint base URL. An empty value clears an account or task override.

model.description: Driver-native model identifier for this custom endpoint.

endpoint.description: Optional custom endpoint supported by the selected agent; task values override profile/account defaults.

traits.description: Public agent trait IDs to resolve under the caller; at most 32. A task list replaces the profile trait list.

context.description: Context keys are projected to each selected trait schema, then merged with its defaults and validated. Task keys override profile keys; undeclared keys are rejected.

tools.description: Optional per-run tool gateway declaration using traits only. Task traits replace profile traits; context keys merge with task values taking precedence.
